card.name: Small linking words in stock phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (without, ever, to, of, during, a colon after DOI) that sit in the middle of a set phrase. It fires in copyright notices, reference lines and drug-label sentences.

modes.label: Citation colon after DOI
modes.description: The colon right after DOI in a journal reference.
modes.example: The American Journal of Human Genetics, 30 December 2010 DOI<<:>> 10.1016

modes.label: Label sentence connectors
modes.description: A preposition or comma in the middle of a drug-label sentence about treatment or dosing.
modes.example: proper dosing and titration<< of>> buprenorphine transdermal
